done_when: When the test lane has a free place, the first waiting test is admitted and starts; a waiter re-checks admission instead of staying blocked on stale holders, and a test reproduces the stuck queue from the issue.
why: A waiting forge test can stay blocked for hours: the machine queue holds only waiting test entries, none admitted or started, yet the waiter keeps saying 5 test processes already run and never starts (issue #1475).
